approvers: Family, my tax adviser and house bank, any successor I might still find
reason: A Belize shell with no track record, no committed funding and no proof of funds is not who I hand my life's work and my six people to. I would only talk to an outside buyer if the family or management route failed, and then to someone with a name and a bank behind them.
objection: Belize holding company, no named funders, no proof of funds. I do not know who is really behind it or whether the money exists, and 30% paid over three years would leave me exposed to them.
instead: Keep running the business and keep looking for a family or management buyout. If that fails, list it on nexxt-change or use a broker or a known German buyer.
would_change_my_mind: Named, verifiable funders with bank-confirmed proof of funds, a German or EU entity, references from past owners, and a larger share of the price paid in cash at closing or secured.
